findings.summary: Split singletons inherit the pre-split batchStartSha, causing a later failing singleton's rollback to revert successful commits made by preceding singletons from the same split.
findings.suggested_fix: Change ReviewBatchWorkItem.batchStartSha type to `string | undefined`. When enqueuing split singletons, set `batchStartSha: undefined`. When dequeuing, resolve it via `const itemBatchStartSha = workItem.batchStartSha ?? itemLiveStartSha;` so each split item correctly anchors its rollback boundary to the HEAD right before it starts.
